landing.eyebrow: Awaaz ke zariye sehat ki rehnumai
landing.headline: Aap ki baat tawajjo se suni jaye.
landing.headline_accent: Guftagu karne wali AI ke saath.
landing.description: Jab tabiyat theek na ho to ek aasaan pehla qadam. Apni alaamaat apne alfaaz mein batayein aur aglay qadam ki wazeh rehnumai hasil karein.
landing.console_subtitle: Awaaz se alaamaat batane ka preview
landing.speak_prompt: Fitri andaaz mein bolein. Aap ki awaaz isi device par rahegi.
landing.mic_privacy: Is preview ke liye awaaz ka tajziya isi device par hota hai; record ya upload nahi hoti.
landing.mic_unsupported: Is browser mein microphone preview dastiyab nahi.
landing.mic_denied: Microphone ki ijazat nahi mili. Aap text se jaari rakh sakte hain.
landing.mic_failed: Microphone shuru nahi ho saka. Barah-e-karam check karein.
landing.console_footer: Aap ki zaban, aap ke alfaaz, agla wazeh qadam.
landing.capabilities_title: Sehat ki rehnumai jo sunne se shuru hoti hai.
landing.capabilities_description: Aasaan symptom triage, taake aap agla qadam chun sakein aur qareebi ilaaj dhoondh sakein.

language.title: Apni zaban mein baat

safety.title: Hifazat ko tarjeeh
safety.description: Khatre ki alaamaat ki jaanch aur mohtaat rehnumai fori madad ki zaroorat wazeh karti hai.

care.title: Qareebi ilaaj ki talaash
care.description: Triage ke baad hospitals aur clinics talaash karein. Ilaaj ki talaash triage ki sifarish nahi badalti.

landing.bottom_prompt: Agla qadam samajh nahi aa raha?

facilities.subtitle: Triage ke baad Google Maps mein qareebi hospitals aur clinics talaash karein.
facilities.api_key_required: App mein Google Map chalu karne ke liye web/.env.local mein VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY configure karein. Google Cloud mein Maps JavaScript API, Places API (New), aur Geocoding API enable karein, billing aur website restrictions lagayein. Key commit na karein.
facilities.map_loading: Google Maps load ho raha hai...
facilities.search_failed: Google Maps facilities talaash nahi kar saka. API key, enabled APIs, billing aur network check karein.
facilities.use_current_location: Meri location ke qareeb talaash karein
facilities.search_manually: Shehar ya address se talaash karein
facilities.searching: Qareebi sahuliyaat talaash ho rahi hain...
facilities.enter_location: Talaash ke liye shehar ya address darj karein.
facilities.geolocation_unsupported: Is browser mein location support nahi. Shehar ya address se talaash karein.
facilities.location_denied: Location access mustarad hui. Ijazat dein ya shehar/address se talaash karein.
facilities.location_unavailable: Aap ki location maloom nahi ho saki. Shehar ya address se talaash karein.
facilities.map_label: Qareebi sehat ki sahuliyaat ka naqsha
facilities.no_results: 5 km ke andar koi sahulat nahi mili. Naqshay mein har qareebi sahulat shamil nahi ho sakti.
facilities.google_fallback: Google Maps mein hospitals talaash karein
facilities.address_unavailable: Naqshay ke data mein address dastiyab nahi.
facilities.data_note: Facilities aur map ka data Google Maps se hai aur na-mukammal ya purana ho sakta hai. Faasla seedha hai, driving ka nahi. Khulne ya staff ki mojoodgi ki tasdeeq nahi ki gayi.
